tasks.title: Conversation #95
tasks.transcript:
Man: You go into the farm as market?
Woman: Yes, I am. I love buying fresh produce and homemade goods there.
Man: Me too. I heard they have a new vendor selling organic honey.
Woman: That sounds interesting. I'll make sure to check it out.
Man: Maybe we can go together and explore all the stalls.

questions.stem: What event are the speakers discussing?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：说话者在讨论什么活动？ 定位原文：Man: You going to the farmers market? 选项分析： A. A festival 节日活动。对话中未提及节日，所以A选项错误。 B. A concert 音乐会。对话中未提及音乐演出，所以B选项错误。 C. A farmers market 农贸市场。男士明确提到“farmers market”，女士也提到购买新鲜农产品和自制商品，所以C选项正确。 D. A marketing workshop 营销研讨会。对话中未提及工作坊或营销相关话题，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: Why is the woman interested in the event?

options.B: She wants to meet new people there.
options.C: She is looking for job opportunities.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：女士为什么对这个活动感兴趣？ 定位原文：Woman: Yes, I am. I love buying fresh produce and homemade goods there. 选项分析： A. She likes making purchases there. 她喜欢在那里购物。女士明确说喜欢在那里购买新鲜农产品和自制商品，所以A选项正确。 B. She wants to meet new people there. 她想在那里认识新朋友。对话中未提及社交目的，所以B选项错误。 C. She is looking for job opportunities. 她在寻找工作机会。对话中未提及工作，所以C选项错误。 D. She enjoys live music. 她喜欢现场音乐。对话中未提及音乐，所以D选项错误。
